facts.text: Pinocchio, finish your soup before it goes cold. Figaro has had his fish, so the scraps on your plate are yours.
facts.why: No such line from Geppetto appears in the plot sources, and no quote page could be opened. It reads as written for the menu, and it is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: Pinocchio, eat while it is hot. Figaro and Cleo have had theirs, so this plate is all yours.

facts.why: Jiminy describes the shop as full of carved wooden clocks, little music boxes and shelves of toys. Cheese is never mentioned.

vibe.verdict: A tidy Italian tavern look, but the poster sits in a frame with black bars and the famous moments are mostly missing.
missing: 'Always let your conscience be your guide' (Jiminy)
Lampwick turning into a donkey (Pleasure Island)
Monstro sneezing the raft out (the whale)
The apple for the teacher (school day)

Swap the poster block for a full-bleed crop so the black bars go.
